## Motivation

`--dcp-comm-backend fi_a2a` (the Blackwell default for MLA decode context parallelism) runs three kernels per MLA layer per
decode step:
1. `dcp_pack_a2a_send` packs the attention output;
2. FlashInfer's MNNVL `helixAllToAllKernel` exchanges it;
3. the Triton `_dcp_lse_combine_kernel` merges it.

FlashInfer's `decode_cp_a2a_lse_reduce` does the exchange and the LSE-weighted merge in **one kernel**:
- flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#4929 added it;
- flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#5726 rewrites its protocol (LL128: no fence or grid barrier on the critical path) and makes it run
  on whichever torch symmetric-memory backend the process uses.

This PR makes `fi_a2a` use that op, and only it.
- The kernel reads the attention output in place (a strided view), so the pack kernel is gone too: three kernels per layer
  become one.
- The workspace lives on torch's default (CUDA) symmetric-memory backend, which it shares with `CustomAllReduceV2`. Nothing
  else in the process changes: no backend switch, custom all-reduce v2 stays on, no `NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE` change.

**Dependency.** This needs a flashinfer-python release that contains flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#5726. sglang currently pins
0.7.0.post1, which has no fused op; the release candidates so far (0.7.1rc1–rc5, 0.7.2rc1) have #4929's version, which
forces the NCCL backend. This PR stays draft until the FlashInfer bump lands. Until then:
- an unset `--dcp-comm-backend` resolves to `a2a` and logs why;
- an explicit `fi_a2a` is rejected at argument resolution;
- a FlashInfer whose op still switches the backend fails at startup with a message naming the fix.

## Modifications

- **`fi_a2a` = the fused kernel, exclusively.** The MNNVL exchange + Triton merge path is removed.
- **Startup, before CUDA-graph capture** (`init_fi_a2a_workspace`):
  - creates two workspaces, one for graph capture and replay and one for eager calls, because a workspace serves one ordered
    CUDA stream;
  - sizes them for the widest decode CUDA-graph batch (`--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode`, times the tokens each request verifies
    under speculative decoding), also with `--disable-decode-cuda-graph`;
  - logs `DCP fi_a2a: fused all-to-all + LSE reduce ready (backend=..., capacity ..., 2 workspaces x ... MiB)` once.
- **Per call** (`fi_a2a_lse_reduce`, a registered custom op, so `torch.compile` sees one opaque collective):
  - views the `[B, H, D]` attention output as `[B, H/cp, cp, D]` and its LSE as `[B, H/cp, cp]` (no copy); head `h` goes to
    peer `h // (H/cp)`, exactly as the pack kernel sent it;
  - picks `lse_mode` from the attention backend;
  - runs eager batches wider than the workspace as several calls, in the same order on every DCP rank.
- **Resolution.**
  - `fi_a2a_platform_blocker`: Blackwell, the DCP group inside one NVLink domain (GB200/GB300 fabric or one node), and a
    FlashInfer that provides the op. It never imports FlashInfer.
  - `fi_a2a_blocker` adds an MLA model, no `--enable-pdmux`, and no PP DeepGEMM warmup stream at `--pp-size > 1`.
  - Unset resolves to `fi_a2a` only where it can run, else `a2a`, and logs the reason. An explicit `fi_a2a` names the blocker.
- **Docs.** `dcp.mdx`, `server_arguments.mdx`, the `--dcp-comm-backend` help, and the Kimi-K3 cookbook note.

## Accuracy Tests

- **New GPU test** `test/registered/kernels/ops/communication/test_dcp_fi_a2a_reduce.py`, at 2 / 4 / 8 × B200: 10 passed,
  0 skipped at each size. It checks:
  - equivalence with the all-gather + Triton merge, base-2 and base-e, at 16 heads × 3 tokens, 16 × 7 (several calls per
    batch) and 2 × 49;
  - FlashMLA's `[B, H, 1]` LSE;
  - CUDA-graph replays interleaved with eager calls;
  - a third CUDA stream is rejected before the collective;
  - custom all-reduce v2 stays exact around fused calls on the same symmetric memory.
- **2 × 4 GB300, the DCP group across two trays of one NVL72:** the test passes on all 8 ranks (9 passed; the all-reduce case
  is skipped because sglang does not build custom all-reduce v2 for that group). DeepSeek-V2-Lite TP 8 = DCP 8: GSM8K 0.640
  for both `fi_a2a` and `a2a`, and TPOT at concurrency 1 is 2.3% lower with `fi_a2a`.
- **GSM8K** (5-shot, 50 questions, `--parallel 1`) on every serving arm below: main 0.80 and this PR 0.76 in every run
  (2 of 50 questions; greedy decoding repeats exactly). The full question set is below.
- **Greedy canary:** four prompts give token-identical outputs on main and this PR: 8 of 8 cross-path run pairs.
- **Coverage of the narrow-graph and eager paths** (GSM8K, 1319 questions, `--parallel 32`):
  - `--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 4`: this PR 0.772, main 0.766;
  - this PR without decode CUDA graphs (eager decode, several calls per batch): 0.767.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

8× B200, DeepSeek-V2-236B BF16, TP 8 = DCP 8, FlashInfer MLA, 256K context, image
`lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20261006-f3fe7534`
(torch 2.14.1, sglang-kernel 0.4.9). FlashInfer 0.7.0.post1 with the op from flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#5726 laid over it, the
same for every arm. Default settings in every arm (custom all-reduce v2 on).

**Per MLA layer** (microbenchmark, 16 heads per rank, `head_dim` 512, 60 calls per CUDA graph, max over ranks of each rank's
median, µs):

| batch | main: pack + MNNVL + combine | this PR | Δ |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 8.08 | 6.55 | −18.9% |
| 2 | 8.21 | 6.85 | −16.6% |
| 4 | 8.82 | 7.27 | −17.6% |
| 8 | 10.68 | 8.20 | −23.2% |
| 16 | 15.05 | 10.50 | −30.2% |
| 32 | 20.60 | 13.97 | −32.2% |
| 64 | 32.38 | 22.38 | −30.9% |
| 128 | 54.47 | 39.23 | −28.0% |

L2 hot, mean of two repeats in one job (palindromic order); with L2 flushed before every layer, 9.51 → 7.25 µs at batch 1.
- **Main's three kernels, timed one at a time** (another job, same node type):
  - pack 1.47 + all-to-all 3.86 + combine 1.58 = 6.91 µs at batch 1;
  - the same three chained cost 8.09 µs in that job. The difference is the gaps between the dependent kernels (nsys in
    serving: 0.26 + 0.60 µs).
- **FlashInfer's current op (#4929), same job:** 27.4 µs at batch 1 and 37.5 µs at batch 32, on contiguous input.

**Serving** (median TPOT, ms, ISL 260992 / OSL 1024). Each job runs main, this PR, this PR, main (or the reverse) on one
node:

| job (order) | concurrency 1: main | this PR | Δ | concurrency 2 Δ | median ITL Δ, concurrency 1 / 2 / 4 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 1 (main, PR, PR, main) | 13.271 | 13.144 | −0.96% | −0.40% | −0.93 / −0.66 / −1.03% |
| 2 (PR, main, main, PR) | 13.227 | 13.120 | −0.81% | −0.63% | −0.88 / −0.90 / −0.79% |
| 3 (main, PR, PR, main) | 13.246 | 13.127 | −0.90% | −0.66% | −0.90 / −0.95 / −0.81% |
| 4 (PR, main, main, PR) | 13.244 | 13.137 | −0.81% | −1.43% | −0.84 / −0.88 / −0.87% |
| **mean** | | | **−0.87%** (4/4) | **−0.78%** | **−0.89 / −0.85 / −0.88%** |

- **Decode-only step time** at 32K context (`one_batch_server`), batch 8 / 16 / 32: −1.19 / −1.14 / −1.52%, lower in all 4
  jobs.
- **Concurrency-4 TPOT** is noisy: only 9 requests finish per run, and TPOT includes stalls behind other requests'
  261K-token prefills.
  - Six of the eight runs of this PR are 0.2–0.5% below main.
  - Two read 46.9 and 58.2 ms (main: 44.5–44.7) while their median ITL, 21.56 and 21.51 ms, matches the other runs of
    this PR.
  - Median ITL at concurrency 4 is −0.88% (−0.79 to −1.03% per job).
- **Control** (`a2a` on main vs this PR, untouched by this change): +0.05% TPOT at concurrency 1.
- **vs `a2a`** (why the resolver keeps preferring `fi_a2a`): TPOT at concurrency 1 is 5.1% lower with `fi_a2a` (13.16 vs
  13.86 ms).
- **Why the FlashInfer version matters.** FlashInfer's current op (#4929, in the 0.7.1 / 0.7.2 release candidates) cannot
  start next to custom all-reduce v2. With v1 all-reduce in every arm, TPOT at concurrency 1 is:
  - main 13.678 ms;
  - the PR's path on #4929's op 15.658 ms (+14.5%), with the inputs copied contiguous;
  - this PR on flashinfer#5726 13.570 ms (−0.79%).

  nsys puts the DCP time per decode step at 568, 2534 and 445 µs respectively.

**nsys** (20 decode steps at concurrency 1; two captures in opposite orders; kernels per decode step on each of the 8 GPUs):

| | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `_dcp_pack_a2a_send_kernel` | 60 (median 1.50 µs) | 0 |
| `helixAllToAllKernel` | 60 (5.44 µs) | 0 |
| `_dcp_lse_combine_kernel` | 60 (1.70 µs) | 0 |
| `flashinfer::comm::dcp::FusedKernel` (base-2) | 0 | 60 (7.26 µs) |
| custom all-reduce v2 kernels | 121 | 121 |
| critical path per layer (last rank's attention end → last rank's reduce end) | 9.41 µs | 7.54 µs |
| × 60 layers, per decode step | 566 µs of 13.22 ms (4.3%) | 453 µs of 13.07 ms (3.5%) |

  both arms). `dcp.mdx` documents the size.

  `decode_cp_a2a_lse_reduce_workspace_size(...)` (two of them), and wider batches are chunked.
- **#42618.** Touches only the `a2a` branch of `dcp_a2a_lse_reduce`.
- **#31785.** Overlaps only textually (`dcp.mdx`, `test_server_args.py`).

+all-gather + Triton merge it replaces, including chunked and graph-replayed
+calls, next to custom all-reduce v2 on the same symmetric memory.

+host can run the fused reduce (Blackwell, FlashInfer with the op).
+"""

+import os
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.dcp_kernels import dcp_lse_combine_triton
+from sglang.srt.distributed import parallel_state as ps
+from sglang.srt.distributed.device_communicators.custom_all_reduce_v2 import (
+    CustomAllReduceV2,
+    can_use_custom_all_reduce_v2,
+)

+from sglang.srt.layers.dcp import comm
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+from sglang.srt.utils.common import fi_a2a_platform_blocker
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.kernels.utils import multigpu_pytest_main
+from sglang.test.test_utils import publish_build_topology
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=120, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="4-gpu-b200")
+
+# Workspace geometry: 3 tokens x 16 heads = 48 rows, so the (heads, batch) cases
+# below cover an exactly-full call and multi-chunk calls.
+MAX_TOKENS, LOCAL_HEADS, HEAD_DIM = 3, 16, 512
+
+_WORLD_SIZE = int(os.environ.get("WORLD_SIZE", "1"))
+_SKIP_REASON = fi_a2a_platform_blocker(
+    dcp_size=_WORLD_SIZE, tp_size=_WORLD_SIZE, pp_size=1, nnodes=1
+)
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    _SKIP_REASON is not None, reason=f"fused fi_a2a reduce {_SKIP_REASON}"
+)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def dcp():
+    rank = int(os.environ["RANK"])
+    local_rank = int(os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"])
+    torch.cuda.set_device(local_rank)
+    ps.init_distributed_environment(
+        world_size=_WORLD_SIZE,
+        rank=rank,
+        local_rank=local_rank,
+        distributed_init_method="env://",
+    )
+    publish_build_topology(tp_size=_WORLD_SIZE, world_rank=rank)
+    # Builds custom all-reduce v2, whose symmetric memory is allocated before the
+    # fused workspaces, as in serving.
+    ps.initialize_model_parallel()
+    group = get_parallel().tp_group
+    capture_stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    comm.init_fi_a2a_workspace(
+        cp_group=group,
+        max_tokens=MAX_TOKENS,
+        local_heads=LOCAL_HEADS,
+        head_dim=HEAD_DIM,
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        capture_stream=capture_stream,
+    )
+    yield group, capture_stream
+    ps.destroy_model_parallel()
+    ps.destroy_distributed_environment()
+
+
+def _partials(group, *, batch, heads, seed):
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed + group.rank_in_group)
+    total_heads = heads * group.world_size
+    out = torch.randn(
+        batch,
+        total_heads,
+        HEAD_DIM,
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        device="cuda",
+        generator=gen,
+    )
+    lse = torch.randn(
+        batch, total_heads, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda", generator=gen
+    )
+    return out, lse
+
+
+def _reference(group, out, lse, *, is_lse_base_on_e):
+    """Gather every rank's partials, keep this rank's heads, merge with Triton."""
+    heads = out.shape[1] // group.world_size
+    own = slice(group.rank_in_group * heads, (group.rank_in_group + 1) * heads)
+    all_out = [torch.empty_like(out) for _ in range(group.world_size)]
+    all_lse = [torch.empty_like(lse) for _ in range(group.world_size)]
+    dist.all_gather(all_out, out, group=group.device_group)
+    dist.all_gather(all_lse, lse, group=group.device_group)
+    merged, _ = dcp_lse_combine_triton(
+        torch.stack([o[:, own] for o in all_out]).contiguous(),
+        torch.stack([s[:, own] for s in all_lse]).contiguous(),
+        is_lse_base_on_e=is_lse_base_on_e,
+    )
+    return merged
+
+
+def _fused(group, out, lse, *, is_lse_base_on_e):
+    return comm.dcp_a2a_lse_reduce(
+        out, lse, group, is_lse_base_on_e=is_lse_base_on_e, comm_backend="fi_a2a"
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("is_lse_base_on_e", [False, True])

+def test_matches_all_gather_reference(dcp, is_lse_base_on_e, heads, batch):
+    """Guards the head-to-peer mapping and the token chunking (B=7 at 16 heads

+    out, lse = _partials(group, batch=batch, heads=heads, seed=11)
+    expected = _reference(group, out, lse, is_lse_base_on_e=is_lse_base_on_e)
+    got = _fused(group, out, lse, is_lse_base_on_e=is_lse_base_on_e)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(got, expected, rtol=1e-2, atol=1e-2)
+

+def test_lse_with_a_trailing_unit_dim_is_accepted(dcp):

+    expected = _reference(group, out, lse, is_lse_base_on_e=True)
+    got = _fused(group, out, lse.unsqueeze(-1), is_lse_base_on_e=True)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(got, expected, rtol=1e-2, atol=1e-2)
+
+
+def test_graph_replay_and_eager_calls_interleave(dcp):
+    """The captured graph and eager decode use different workspaces on one
+    ordered stream; replays and eager calls must not corrupt each other."""
+    group, capture_stream = dcp
+    static_out, static_lse = _partials(group, batch=2, heads=LOCAL_HEADS, seed=31)
+    capture_stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    with torch.cuda.stream(capture_stream):
+        _fused(group, static_out, static_lse, is_lse_base_on_e=False)
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=capture_stream):
+            static_result = _fused(
+                group, static_out, static_lse, is_lse_base_on_e=False
+            )
+    torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(capture_stream)
+    for step in range(3):
+        new_out, new_lse = _partials(group, batch=2, heads=LOCAL_HEADS, seed=40 + step)
+        static_out.copy_(new_out)
+        static_lse.copy_(new_lse)
+        graph.replay()
+        eager_out, eager_lse = _partials(
+            group, batch=3, heads=LOCAL_HEADS, seed=50 + step
+        )
+        eager_result = _fused(group, eager_out, eager_lse, is_lse_base_on_e=False)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            static_result,
+            _reference(group, new_out, new_lse, is_lse_base_on_e=False),
+            rtol=1e-2,
+            atol=1e-2,
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            eager_result,
+            _reference(group, eager_out, eager_lse, is_lse_base_on_e=False),
+            rtol=1e-2,
+            atol=1e-2,
+        )
+

+def test_third_stream_raises_before_the_collective(dcp):
+    """Only the capture and serving streams own a workspace; a third stream
+    must fail on the host on every rank, not spin in the kernel."""
+    group, _ = dcp
